scope.inclusionRule: Include every public nomad-agent Actor whose current title or slug identifies a job-search, job-enrichment, job-bundle, or candidate-fit product, plus every public jobatlas deployment maintained by this repository.
scope.evidenceBoundary: The owned-account totals retain their dated historical snapshot. Public endpoints and latest build metadata were rechecked on 4 October 2026. Build metadata does not prove a successful execution, complete descriptions, optional processing or destination delivery. The complete public directory also covers the non-job products excluded from this job integration catalogue. Input examples are documentation and do not guarantee matching results.

contractProfiles.emptyValueSemantics: Unknown scalar values stay null, known-empty collections stay [], and raw: null is valid when raw capture is disabled.

contractProfiles.emptyValueSemantics: A fit row keeps the source posting jobKey and uses candidate-specific matchKey for destination upserts; it is never passed through the flat-job mapper.

contractProfiles.name: Historical simple job row v2
contractProfiles.emptyValueSemantics: Optional scalar facts are null. Locations are [] when no usable source location was parsed. Full description and HTML are mandatory.

contractProfiles.name: normalized job v1
contractProfiles.emptyValueSemantics: Unknown facts stay null and known-empty collections stay []. Complete raw text is always retained; source HTML may be unavailable.

contractProfiles.name: Simple source job row v3
contractProfiles.emptyValueSemantics: Unknown scalar facts and employmentTypes stay null; locations are [] when no usable location is parsed, and hiringContacts are [] when no named people are supplied. Full description and HTML are mandatory. No recordType field.

externalStateMatrix.action: Create a corresponding Job Atlas Task or confirm an in-place transfer before changing any caller Task ID.
externalStateMatrix.verification: Read back actId, build selector, caps, and a redacted input hash before enabling the replacement.
externalStateMatrix.rollback: Keep the old Task disabled but intact until the replacement passes its approved canary.
gaps: The list endpoint did not expose each Task's full run options or input.
No Task currently observed was bound to a Job Atlas copy.

externalStateMatrix.action: Clone or rebind only after the target Actor or Task identity and destination owner are approved.
externalStateMatrix.verification: Compare conditions and event types, then test one disposable terminal event only with destination-write approval.
externalStateMatrix.rollback: Disable the replacement and restore the prior hook binding without deleting either configuration.
gaps: Destination secrets and full payload templates were intentionally not collected.
A metadata read does not prove destination delivery.

externalStateMatrix.action: Import a fresh inactive workflow or scenario and reselect credentials; do not overwrite a working import.
externalStateMatrix.verification: Inspect every Actor route, Task placeholder, internal template ID, schedule state, and destination mapping before activation.
externalStateMatrix.rollback: Retain the previous inactive export and revert by disabling the new import.
gaps: No authenticated n8n, Make, or Zapier editor import was authorized.
Duplicated template-internal n8n IDs need editor-side regeneration checks.

externalStateMatrix.action: Keep existing schedules unchanged; migrate a schedule only with its exact Task or Actor dependency.
externalStateMatrix.verification: Read back enabled state, timezone, cron expression, target ID, selector, and charge cap before and after an approved change.
externalStateMatrix.rollback: Restore the prior target and enabled state from the pre-change read-back.
gaps: Current public migration candidates had no observed owned schedule binding.
Customer-owned schedules are not visible from this account inventory.

externalStateMatrix.action: Ask Apify to confirm pricing, payout, existing-user, and subscription behavior before any transfer, archive, or copy cutover.
externalStateMatrix.verification: Compare pricing configuration and a bounded charge receipt on the exact replacement only after approval.
externalStateMatrix.rollback: Keep the original deployment public and unchanged until commercial continuity is confirmed.
gaps: Metadata showed pay-per-event pricing on the promoted pairs but cannot prove customer or payout continuity.
Official transfer guidance does not document every monetization consequence.

externalStateMatrix.action: Reselect credentials in each imported client; never embed or copy secrets into repository assets.
externalStateMatrix.verification: Confirm least-privilege access and one bounded authenticated read before any run or destination test.
externalStateMatrix.rollback: Disable the new client and retain the prior credential binding in its original platform.
gaps: Customer credential stores were not accessed.
Repository placeholders do not prove a usable authentication path.

externalStateMatrix.action: Use a disposable named destination for a separately approved create-and-update canary before enabling recurrence.
externalStateMatrix.verification: Record the destination identity, exact source run, one create, one idempotent update, and visible final values.
externalStateMatrix.rollback: Remove only canary rows and disable the replacement workflow; preserve the prior destination configuration.
gaps: No destination credentials or write authorization were provided.
Artifact validation and Actor execution do not prove destination delivery.
